symbols.name: FilterModelSchemaTransformer
symbols.summary: Completes incomplete FilterModel-related schemas in the OpenAPI document.
symbols.remarks: The .NET 9 OpenAPI generator creates incomplete schemas for types that are only referenced indirectly (e.g., BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.FilterCriteria is only used inside List<FilterCriteria>). This transformer enhances these incomplete schemas with their full definitions during schema generation. Key responsibilities: Completes schemas for all FilterModel-related types with their full property definitionsDefines enum values inline where they are used (not as separate schema references)Handles polymorphic types like BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.SpecificationNodeRemoves temporary dummy properties used for schema discoveryAdds proper descriptions and references to all properties

symbols.name: TransformAsync(OpenApiSchema, OpenApiSchemaTransformerContext, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Transforms OpenAPI schemas for FilterModel and related types.
symbols.remarks: This method is called during the OpenAPI schema generation phase for each type discovered. It dispatches to specific completion methods based on the type being transformed.
